tools.name: search_birds
tools.description: Search common/scientific names and guide text; optionally filter by exact family. Returns compact records and pagination. Empty query lists all birds.

tools.name: get_bird
tools.description: Get the complete guide entry and canonical source links for an exact bird ID from search_birds.

tools.name: list_families
tools.description: List bird families/categories present in this catalog, with counts and source links.
